title: Val3dityValidateRequest
description: Body of POST /validate to the val3dity image (3D-74; 3D-ADR-0008). `document` is the CityJSON the kernel export wrote for one building (3D-11); the image runs val3dity on it with `parameters` and replies with a validate-response.
$comment: D-446, D-447. [P] Member names. Parameters come from the tolerance profile (D-13, D-447): snapTolM = topologySnapTolM -> val3dity --snap_tol; planarityD2pTolM = planarTolM -> --planarity_d2p_tol; planarityNormalsTolDeg = 20 (val3dity default; the profile has no such field) -> --planarity_n_tol. --overlap_tol is not sent (val3dity default). The document is not validated here beyond its type: checking it is val3dity's job (9xx dataset errors).
